senses.sense_definition: Miscellaneous items or equipment needed for a specific activity.

examples.text: He has an impressive collection of bicycling <w>paraphernalia</w>, but he does not ride very often anymore.
The hikers packed all their camping <w>paraphernalia</w> into their bags before starting the long journey.

senses.sense_definition: Personal belongings of a married woman, such as clothing and jewelry, excluding her dowry.

examples.text: The legal document clearly distinguished between the woman's dowry and her personal <w>paraphernalia</w>.
She gathered her clothes and <w>paraphernalia</w> before leaving her husband's house.

traits.comment: Refers to a specific historical legal concept.
